note: Carriers and oracles frozen before any round-40 after-run. Each carrier is a genuine AVM-layout big-endian SquashFS v4 image: sqsh magic, AVM marker (mkfs_time == bytes_used), little-endian metadata block-length headers. sha256 is the carrier pin; oracle holds regular files (relpath, sha256, size); nonregular holds every non-regular entry (relpath, kind, detail) with kind in dir|symlink|char-device|block-device|fifo|socket; receipt is the round-40 REA extract-firmware after-receipt path for that carrier.
